source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Anita (2026-09-05 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Anita
note: Anita,农舍和花园里用 Jacob 的票券和奖牌换农具、加成的女商贩,Jacob 的搭档。说话轻快活泼(Hey hey hey! / Sweet! / Yay),对玩家像熟客;Abiphone 台词有点小傲娇。中文用「嘿嘿嘿」「耶」这类口语,不写成客服腔。
source_note: 首次对话第二句实测是「for useful items!」,两家 Wiki 都写「for farming tools!」;Wiki 2026-09-05 才更新过,差一个名词短语,两种写法都保留。

messages.text: I'll trade your Jacob's Tickets for useful items!
messages.gloss: Jacob's Ticket → Jacob 的票券,人名保留;这是实测写法。
messages.zh: 拿你的 Jacob 的票券来,我给你换实用的好东西!

segments.zh: 来,我给你换实用的好东西!

messages.text: I'll trade your Jacob's Tickets for farming tools!
messages.zh: 拿你的 Jacob 的票券来,我给你换农具!

messages.text: ✆ I only share my contact with those who are on Jacob's contact list.
messages.zh: ✆ 我只把联系方式给 Jacob 通讯录里的人。

messages.text: ✆ Oh and also, you need to have earned a GOLD medal in his contest if you want to be on MY list!
messages.zh: ✆ 哦对了,想进我的通讯录,你还得在他的竞赛里拿过金牌才行!

messages.text: ✆ If I need any farming done back home, I'll be sure to call ya!
messages.zh: ✆ 家里要是有农活要干,我一定打给你!

messages.raw: §fHey hey hey again! I'll trade you some copper for some carrots!
messages.text: Hey hey hey again! I'll trade you some copper for some carrots!
messages.zh: 嘿嘿嘿,又见面啦! 给我些胡萝卜,我拿铜跟你换!
